svg.aria-label: About Dhruvil Dhamecha: disciplined, consistent, relentless. A software engineer and cyber security mind who finishes what he starts and fears nothing.
svg.title: About Me: The Devil in the Code
svg.desc: Daredevil-themed about me card for Dhruvil Dhamecha. A masked portrait beside three principles: consistency is my armor, what I start I finish, fear doesn't get a vote. Closing line: there are other ways to see.

g.text: Systematic by choice. Relentless by nature.
No shortcuts, no excuses. I show up in the dark, every single night.
Once I take a job, it ends only one way: done, and done right.
Long odds, hard nights, broken plans. I take the hit, rise, and keep moving.
I don’t chase applause. I trust the process.
When the city sleeps, I keep working. No noise, no excuses—
just discipline, consistency, and control over what matters.
THE MAN WITHOUT FEAR · HELL’S KITCHEN · NIGHT WATCH
